answer: Score jurors with a truth serum. Each juror submits a grade plus a forecast of how the rest of the panel will grade, and pay favors grades that turn out more common than forecast. Sock puppets grading their own farm's answer all give the same inflated score and the same forecast, so they sit at one vertex the honest panel never visits and earn nothing. Swinging a verdict needs most seats on a randomly drawn panel, so a farm must buy a tide of identities to win an ember of reward, and each losing seat forfeits its bond.
